question.EN: Which cell organelle is known as the 'powerhouse of the cell'?
question.HI: निम्नलिखित में से किस कोशिकांग को 'कोशिका का ऊर्जा गृह' कहा जाता है?

explanation.EN: Mitochondria generate ATP through cellular respiration, earning them the nickname 'powerhouse of the cell'.
explanation.HI: माइटोकॉन्ड्रिया कोशिकीय श्वसन के माध्यम से ATP का निर्माण करते हैं, इसीलिए इन्हें 'कोशिका का ऊर्जा गृह' कहा जाता है।

question.EN: The fluid mosaic model of the plasma membrane was proposed by:
question.HI: प्लाज्मा झिल्ली का तरल मोज़ेक मॉडल (Fluid Mosaic Model) किसके द्वारा प्रस्तावित किया गया था?

explanation.EN: Singer and Nicolson proposed the fluid mosaic model in 1972, describing the membrane as a fluid structure with embedded proteins.
explanation.HI: सिंगर और निकोल्सन ने 1972 में तरल मोज़ेक मॉडल प्रस्तावित किया, जिसमें झिल्ली को एक तरल संरचना के रूप में वर्णित किया गया जिसमें प्रोटीन अंतःस्थापित होते हैं।

question.EN: Which of the following organelles is double membrane-bound?
question.HI: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा कोशिकांग द्विझिल्लीयुक्त (double membrane-bound) होता है?

explanation.EN: Mitochondria and chloroplasts are double membrane-bound organelles, unlike ribosomes, Golgi, and lysosomes which are single-membraned or membrane-less.
explanation.HI: माइटोकॉन्ड्रिया और हरितलवक (क्लोरोप्लास्ट) द्विझिल्लीयुक्त कोशिकांग हैं, जबकि राइबोसोम, गॉल्जी उपकरण और लाइसोसोम या तो एकल-झिल्लीयुक्त होते हैं या झिल्लीरहित होते हैं।

question.HI: राइबोसोम किससे मिलकर बने होते हैं?

explanation.EN: Ribosomes are ribonucleoprotein particles made of rRNA and proteins, and are the site of protein synthesis.
explanation.HI: राइबोसोम राइबोन्यूक्लियोप्रोटीन कण होते हैं जो rRNA और प्रोटीन से बने होते हैं, और ये प्रोटीन संश्लेषण का स्थल होते हैं।

question.EN: Which organelle is called the 'suicide bag' of the cell?
question.HI: कोशिका का 'आत्मघाती थैली' (suicide bag) किस कोशिकांग को कहा जाता है?

explanation.EN: Lysosomes contain hydrolytic enzymes that can digest the cell's own components during autolysis, hence the name 'suicide bag'.
explanation.HI: लाइसोसोम में जल-अपघटनी (hydrolytic) एंजाइम होते हैं जो स्वतः अपघटन (autolysis) के दौरान कोशिका के अपने घटकों को पचा सकते हैं, इसीलिए इन्हें 'आत्मघाती थैली' कहा जाता है।

question.EN: Which cell type lacks a defined nucleus?
question.HI: किस प्रकार की कोशिका में सुस्पष्ट केंद्रक (defined nucleus) नहीं होता?

explanation.EN: Prokaryotic cells (e.g., bacteria) lack a membrane-bound nucleus; their genetic material lies in the nucleoid region.
explanation.HI: प्रोकैरियोटिक कोशिकाओं (जैसे जीवाणु) में झिल्लीयुक्त केंद्रक नहीं होता; इनका आनुवंशिक पदार्थ केंद्रकाभ (nucleoid) क्षेत्र में स्थित होता है।

question.EN:
Match Column I with Column II to identify the correct events occurring during Prophase I of Meiosis:
Column I: (a) Zygotene (b) Pachytene (c) Diplotene (d) Diakinesis
Column II: (i) Terminalisation of chiasmata (ii) Synapsis of homologous chromosomes (iii) Crossing over and recombination (iv) Dissolution of synaptonemal complex
question.HI:
Match Column I with Column II to identify the correct events occurring during Prophase I of Meiosis:
Column I: (a) Zygotene (b) Pachytene (c) Diplotene (d) Diakinesis
Column II: (i) Terminalisation of chiasmata (ii) Synapsis of homologous chromosomes (iii) Crossing over and recombination (iv) Dissolution of synaptonemal complex

explanation.EN: NCERT explicit events: Zygotene is characterized by chromosome pairing called synapsis. Pachytene shows the appearance of recombination nodules where crossing over occurs. Diplotene is marked by the dissolution of the synaptonemal complex making X-shaped chiasmata visible. Diakinesis is marked by the terminalisation of these chiasmata.
explanation.HI: NCERT explicit events: Zygotene is characterized by chromosome pairing called synapsis. Pachytene shows the appearance of recombination nodules where crossing over occurs. Diplotene is marked by the dissolution of the synaptonemal complex making X-shaped chiasmata visible. Diakinesis is marked by the terminalisation of these chiasmata.

question.EN: Identify the phase of cell division shown in the provided diagram where homologous chromosomes separate while sister chromatids remain associated at their centromeres.
question.HI: Identify the phase of cell division shown in the provided diagram where homologous chromosomes separate while sister chromatids remain associated at their centromeres.

explanation.EN: During Anaphase I of Meiosis, homologous chromosomes separate and move toward opposite poles, but sister chromatids remain attached at their centromeres. In contrast, sister chromatids split during Mitotic Anaphase and Anaphase II.
explanation.HI: During Anaphase I of Meiosis, homologous chromosomes separate and move toward opposite poles, but sister chromatids remain attached at their centromeres. In contrast, sister chromatids split during Mitotic Anaphase and Anaphase II.

question.HI: Which organelle contains digestive hydrolytic enzymes and is involved in intracellular digestion?

explanation.EN: Lysosomes contain hydrolytic enzymes involved in intracellular digestion and recycling.

question.EN: Which cellular structure is the site of ribosome assembly in eukaryotic cells?
question.HI: Which cellular structure is the site of ribosome assembly in eukaryotic cells?

explanation.EN: The nucleolus is the nuclear region where rRNA synthesis and ribosomal subunit assembly occur.
explanation.HI: The nucleolus is the nuclear region where rRNA synthesis and ribosomal subunit assembly occur.

question.HI: Which organelle is especially abundant in cells specialised for protein secretion?

question.HI: Which structure is continuous with the outer nuclear membrane and bears ribosomes on its surface?

explanation.EN: Rough endoplasmic reticulum is continuous with the nuclear envelope and may bear ribosomes.
explanation.HI: Rough endoplasmic reticulum is continuous with the nuclear envelope and may bear ribosomes.

question.EN: Which organelle contains catalase and participates in detoxification of hydrogen peroxide?
question.HI: Which organelle contains catalase and participates in detoxification of hydrogen peroxide?

explanation.EN: Peroxisomes contain oxidative enzymes including catalase, which helps break down hydrogen peroxide.

question.HI: Which cytoskeletal component forms the spindle fibres during cell division?
